# global-hub

Multicluster Global Hub operator and instance on the global hub

Guide: https://policystk.io/elements/global-hub/

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  globalHub:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

One MulticlusterGlobalHub, multiclusterglobalhub in multicluster-global-hub. The operator deploys and manages its own Kafka (AMQ Streams), PostgreSQL and Grafana. On a disconnected hub it takes AMQ Streams from the catalog global.catalogSources maps redhat-operators to.

Under `stack.globalHub.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `availabilityConfig` | High runs two replicas of the manager and Grafana and three Kafka brokers, Basic one of each: High or Basic. Kafka keeps the broker count it was created with. spec.availabilityConfig | `High` |
| `retention` | How long PostgreSQL keeps history, in years (y) and months (m): 18m, 1y, 1y6m. spec.dataLayer.postgres.retention | `18m` |
| `storageClass` | StorageClass of the Kafka and PostgreSQL volumes; empty uses the cluster default. Set it before the first enable: changing it later breaks the PostgreSQL reconcile. spec.dataLayer.storageClass | `''` |

## Operators

Each renders into Policy `install` with `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-global-hub` | `multicluster-global-hub-operator-rh` | `release-1.8` | `redhat-operators` | `multicluster-global-hub` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `config`

`config-global-hub-<cluster>`: Deploy the MulticlusterGlobalHub instance. Depends on `install-global-hub-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config-global-hub` | enforce | medium | `install-global-hub-status`<br>compliant while pending | [global-hub](converters/config/global-hub.yaml) | The MulticlusterGlobalHub |

### Policy `install`

`install-global-hub-<cluster>`: Install and manage the Multicluster Global Hub Operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-global-hub` | enforce | medium | [operator](#operators) `multicluster-global-hub-operator-rh` | Multicluster Global Hub Operator |

### Policy `ready`

`ready-global-hub-<cluster>`: Reports NonCompliant until every Global Hub component is available. Depends on `config-global-hub-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ready-global-hub` | inform (always) | medium | [global-hub](converters/ready/global-hub.yaml) | MulticlusterGlobalHub in phase Running |
